description:
THE roster tool: investable MEMBER companies of a theme (curated membership). Rolls up sub-themes
    (a parent node returns its children's members too). Use this — not screen_stocks — for 'who are the
    players / real names in <theme>' (screen_stocks is a NEWS-ranked subset gated to news-epicenter members).
    `country='all'` (default) gives the complete cross-market list; an ISO-2 scopes to one trading venue.
    Different from top_entities (news-derived). `limit` = how many (default 20, max 50; big themes have many).
    Returns {stocks, count, total, note?} — if `total` > `count` it's a TOP SLICE: say so, don't present it
    as the full roster (raise `limit`).

country.description: `all` (DEFAULT) = the whole cross-market roster — use this for 'who are the players in <theme>'. Or an ISO-2 market to scope to ONE venue. ⚠️ keyed by LISTING VENUE, not domicile: a foreign name lists under the market it TRADES on (Leonardo/Saab under GB via their LSE line, Novo under US/DE, Cameco under US) — so a home-country query (IT/SE/DK/CA) can return 0 even though the company IS a member. When in doubt use `all`.
country.title: Country

exposure.description: Filter by exposure tier (e.g. `core`). Omit → all members.
exposure.title: Exposure

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, hard cap 50). Keep SMALL + narrow the scope; page/refine rather than dump — heavily-covered assets have hundreds of articles.
limit.title: Limit

theme.description: A megatrend theme — name/slug (resolved for you) or node id.
theme.title: Theme
